## Exact algebraic observation
Fix a convex body with vertices x_i and facet inequalities n_i dot x<=h_i. For an interior reference center c, physical escape (x_i-c) dot(x_j-x_i) is affine in c. Set alpha_i=h_i-n_i dot c>0 and polar q_i(c)=n_i/alpha_i. The sign of q_i(c) dot(q_j(c)-q_i(c)) equals the sign of
alpha_i(n_i dot n_j)-alpha_j||n_i||^2,
which is also affine in c. The omitted denominator alpha_i^2 alpha_j is strictly positive. Thus for specified physical and polar rooted witness trees and inward root inequalities, strict reference110 escape conditions form an intersection of open affine halfspaces in three center coordinates. Their union over valid choices describes the corresponding strict escape region; a finite policy search is not an exhaustive enumeration of that union. Existence of a reference-center cell still does not solve actual material/mass closure. This algebra is a derivation, not a claim that the polar's own uniform centroid is preserved.
